description: Tool to retrieve a list of event type hosts (memberships) for a specific event type. Use when you need to see which users are configured as hosts for an event type.

inputSchema.description: Request model for listing event type memberships (hosts).

count.description: Number of results to return per page. Must be a positive integer.
count.title: Count

event_type.description: URI of the event type to retrieve memberships for. Format: 'https://api.calendly.com/event_types/{uuid}'. Pass the complete URI, not just the UUID.
event_type.title: Event Type

page_token.description: Pagination token to retrieve a specific page of results. Use the 'next_page_token' from a previous response to get the next page.
page_token.title: Page Token
